about.title: A portfolio that shows the work behind the CV
about.intro: Add your projects once, tell the story behind each of them, and share one link that works everywhere — on your CV, LinkedIn, in an email or on paper.

permalink.body: Your portfolio lives at a short address with a QR code, ready for CVs and slides.

caseStudies.title: The story behind each project
caseStudies.body: Each project gets its own page: role, period, stack, screenshots and the story in Markdown.

languages.title: In several languages
languages.body: The site speaks English, French and Swedish, and you can translate your own texts.

community.title: Part of a community
community.body: Show which communities you belong to, find collaborators, and get inspired by others.

about.history: The platform started as the ALX Hall of Fame, a showcase for ALX software engineering learners and alumni. It is now open to everyone — ALX members keep their community badge.
